getAuditLogs().details: Unbounded read; intended for off-chain `eth_call` only.

returns.found: True when the digest has been anchored at least once.
returns.index: Global index of the first record carrying that digest.

params.clientId: Logical identifier of the submitting participant.
params.ipfsCID: IPFS CID of the adapter, or "" when IPFS is disabled.
params.modelHash: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the adapter artefact.
params.round: Federated round index this update belongs to.

getLog(uint256).notice: Return a single record by its global index.

getLogsByRound(uint256).notice: Return every record anchored for a given federated round.

getRoundLogCount(uint256).notice: Number of records anchored for a given round.

isHashRegistered(string).notice: Membership check used by verifiers to prove an artefact was         actually registered by the federation.
